say:1:1030213001:0.text: Who wants to work if there's not a family to raise?
say:1:1030213001:0.source_cn: 要不是为了养家糊口，谁会想出来干活？！

say:2:1030213002:0.text:
I wish I could be like a cat, just basking in the sun on the rooftop every day...
And someone would feed and pamper me.
say:2:1030213002:0.source_cn: 真想像猫一样，每天躺在房顶上舒服地晒太阳，什么也不干…...
